text:
June: Planning thread for the 'Spark' launch newsletter. Goal: webinar signups + benchmark reads while protecting sender reputation. Draft plan in the sheet: https://docs.google.com/spark-launch

Rafi: Segments: insiders (3.2k), power-users (22k), newsletter-only (110k), cold-reactivate (5k). insiders get roadmap CTA, power-users get config walkthrough, cold-reactivate gets soft re-intro.

Tess: Proposed A/B: power-users subject A/B and CTA test; insiders single variant with stronger ask; newsletter-only control for deliverability baseline + 1 small variant sample (5%).

Hugo: Deliverability constraints: we can push 9k/hr on primary provider if warmed. For newsletter-only we'll cap at 6k/hr and rotate domains. Seed send to 45 internal accounts (Gmail/Outlook/Yahoo) tomorrow morning.

Iris: Copy notes: preheader under 85 chars. insiders tone: technical with "roadmap preview" CTA. power-users: case study + "Apply this config" CTA. cold-reactivate: short survey + re-engagement CTA. I'll drop 4 templates + plain-text by 16:00 PT.

June: Timezone windows: APAC 11:00-14:00 local, EMEA 09:00-11:00, US 13:00-15:00. If no tz, fallback to inferred country. Rafi please export tz mapping.

Rafi: Will export in 20m and mark ~3% with unknown tz to be sent in region-appropriate default windows.

Hugo: Send CLI for ops (staged):
```
send --env prod --campaign spark_launch --wave seed --limit 3200 --note=preview
send --env prod --campaign spark_launch --wave power_users --limit 6000 --ramp 10/30/60 --variants A,B
send --env prod --campaign spark_launch --wave newsletter_chunk --limit 6000 --repeat 18 --rotate-domains
```
I'll monitor bounce >1% or complaint rate >0.04% and pause if hit.

Tess: Tracking: add UTMs per-variant (utm_campaign=spark_launch, utm_content=variantA|B), server-side open ping for accuracy, and capture raw headers for deliverability postmortem if needed.

June: Inbound routing: clicks from power-users that reach /signup -> tag as "hot_lead" and webhook to SDR queue 'spark-ready'. Rafi set rule: >2 clicks in 24h escalate.

Iris: Accessibility: alt text on images, plain-text version, contrast check, and test dark mode. Also remove emoji from subject lines for newsletter-only.

sendbot: Waves scheduled:
- seed_preview ts=1791237600 recipients=45
- insiders_wave ts=1791241200 recipients=3200 variant=single
- power_users_wave ts=1791244800 recipients=22000 variants=A/B ramp=10/30/60
- newsletter_rollout ts=1791252000 recipients=110000 window=48h chunks=18
- cold_reactivate ts=1791320000 recipients=5000 drip=3d

June: Owners: Iris finalize copy + plain-text by EOD, Hugo run warmup + domain rotation tonight, Rafi export tz mapping and build inbound rules, Tess build variant UTMs and QA links. We'll do a quick seed inbox check at T+1h and reconvene after wave 1 to capture learnings. :rocket:
